install_fairotag_package: install the fairotag python package using pip install with all required dependencies
review_fairotag_dependencies: review the fairotag setup.py to check required dependencies like gtsam, numpy, opencv, scipy, and sophuspy
summarize_fairotag_setup: summarize the fairotag setup.py configuration including package name, version, and install requirements
build_fairotag_package: build the fairotag python package from source using python setup.py with the python directory as package root
refactor_fairotag_dependencies: refactor the fairotag setup.py to update or add new install_requires dependencies
